methods.name: Sea charting
methods.note: One-off charting tasks from the captain's log, the best early XP. Prying Times at 12 and Current Affairs at 22 unlock more. All tasks need 78.

methods.name: Courier tasks between early ports
methods.note: Carry cargo between Port Sarim, The Pandemonium and, from 10, Musa Point. Two tasks at once from 7 and three from 28. Chart the seas on the way.

methods.name: Shipwreck salvaging with one hook
methods.note: Skiff with a salvaging hook and cargo hold. Better wrecks at 26, 35 and 53, better hooks at 21, 27 and 44. A salvaging station from 42 sorts at sea.

methods.name: The Tempor Tantrum
methods.note: First Barracuda Trial. Skiff needs an iron helm and an oak mast with linen sails. Rate is the Marlin rank finished at its target time.

methods.name: Courier tasks Summer Shore route
methods.note: Take Musa Point, Port Sarim or Pandemonium tasks at The Summer Shore and deliver them back, about nine trips an hour. Skiff with oak sails.

methods.name: Shipwreck salvaging with two hooks
methods.note: Sloop with two hooks, one worked by a crewmate, and a salvaging station. Pirate wrecks at 64, mercenary 73, Fremennik 80, merchant 87. Very low input.

methods.name: The Jubbly Jive
methods.note: Second Barracuda Trial. Skiff needs a mithril helm and an inoculation station, which uses Relicym's balm. Rate is the Marlin rank at its target time.

methods.name: Deep sea trawling
methods.note: Sloop with two trawling nets on giant krill shoals, trains Fishing too. Halibut at 83 Fishing or bluefin at 87 give 57,000 to 60,000 from 84 Sailing.

methods.name: Courier tasks Rellekka route
methods.note: Take Rellekka tasks, teleport to Aldarin, summon the boat and deliver north along the coast. Etceteria at 65 adds tasks. Depends on the notice board.

methods.name: Courier tasks Prifddinas route
methods.note: Take tasks at Prifddinas, Port Tyras, Deepfin Point and Aldarin, summon the boat to Aldarin and deliver back towards Prifddinas.

methods.name: The Gwenith Glide
methods.note: Third Barracuda Trial and the fastest Sailing XP. Skiff needs an adamant keel. Marlin rank at its target time, with a crystal extractor from 73.

methods.name: Courier tasks Lunar Isle route
methods.note: Stack round-trip tasks to Lunar Isle from Aldarin, Deepfin Point and Civitas illa Fortis, then fill spare slots on the way. Five tasks at once from 84.

unverified: All Sailing methods: the Sailing training page is flagged obsolete ('various Sailing updates have left parts of the guide out of date'); the Ironman Guide states no hourly rates for any Sailing method, so nothing could be cross-checked against it
Sea charting: no hourly rate is given below level 22 (xph 0); 'around 10,000 an hour at level 22' is the only figure, and charting XP is one-off, not repeatable
Courier tasks between early ports: no hourly rate is given (xph 0); the Ironman Guide only says small-wreck salvaging gives 'similar experience per hour to port tasks'

Shipwreck salvaging with one hook: midpoints of the table; many hook and wreck pairs are 'Unknown'; the table assumes a deckhandiness 4 crewmate, who cannot be hired before 60 Sailing; 5,250 at 27 is the fisherman's wreck (26) with a steel hook (27); steel and mithril hooks need Construction 18 and 30

Shipwreck salvaging with two hooks: midpoints of the table; bands assume mithril hooks at 50, adamant at 59 (Construction 52) and rune at 74 (Construction 66); dragon hooks give 80,000-95,000 at merchant wrecks; the Ironman Guide says mercenary wrecks need an adamant helm; tick manipulation (2 to 2.5 times) is left out
The Tempor Tantrum: computed from the page's formula (Marlin 1,907 XP per 270 s target plus 10 s; Swordfish gives 19,342 and Shark 21,938 an hour); the ranks unlock in order

The Jubbly Jive: computed from the page's formula (Marlin 8,176 XP per 321 s target plus 10 s; Swordfish gives 64,746 and Shark 80,905 an hour); the inoculation station needs partial completion of Zogre Flesh Eaters, which the q: syntax cannot express

The Gwenith Glide: computed from the page's formula (Marlin 19,410 XP per 369 s target plus 10 s; Swordfish gives 113,538 and Shark 144,543 an hour); the 73 band adds the page's crystal extractor term of 13,750, and the extractor also needs 67 Construction; the page says a rosewood hull at 93 pushes this to 200,000 or more
Courier tasks Summer Shore, Rellekka, Prifddinas and Lunar Isle routes: the page calls these rough estimates extrapolated from tests made before courier XP rose 10% on 3 June 2026, not yet retested
Courier tasks Rellekka route: 99,000 at 65 is for 'favourable routes' and depends heavily on the tasks offered
Courier tasks Lunar Isle route: midpoint of 130,000-160,000, which may include crystal extractor XP; the page states no quest requirement for reaching Lunar Isle

Deep sea trawling: the page's estimates are undated and it cannot say whether they include the May 2026 doubling of trawling Sailing XP; krill rows used (8,500 is the midpoint for rope nets, baited and unbaited not separated); the 57,000-60,000 halibut and bluefin figures include crystal extractor XP; no estimate exists for hemp nets, yellowfin or marlin; Construction levels for the nets are not given
Bounty tasks and the crystal extractor (about 10,000 an hour on top of any method from 73) are described on the page without a usable hourly rate and are not listed as methods
Quests: Pandemonium has no Sailing requirement ('-' on the training page, 1 on the Sailing page)
